build_metadata.implementation: native C++ retained-click sampler with Gaussian zero updates

pairwise_score_policy.structural_zero: exact zero original 2x2 covariance crossblock gives MI=0
pairwise_score_policy.precision: explicit long-double scalar 2x2 factors and whitening

cpp_result.pairwise_score_policy: v3 exact structural zeros; long-double whitening/determinant-ratio delta; stable binary-KL remainder; physical-index ties; no score floor
cpp_result.mask_convention: bit i is physical mode i; one is a click
cpp_result.step_cache_scope: one conditional; ordered physical subsets; no cross-step reuse
cpp_result.enumerated_law: product of computed conditional probabilities under ideal continuous uniforms; not a finite PRNG-state enumeration
cpp_result.profiling_notes: Selection inclusive contains selection event time; use overhead plus event for nonoverlapping totals. Scratch-cache preparation is separate; loop/output work is unclassified. Timers run only with --profile.
